title: Representable pullback is constant from exhaustive evaluation
statement: Let U be a nonempty connected scheme [def-weil-connected-scheme], A and P finite etale U-schemes [def-galois-categories], with A connected, and let s:Spec Ω -> U be an algebraically closed geometric point [def-galois-fibre-functor]. Fix a in A_s. If evaluation Hom_U(A,P) -> P_s at a is bijective, the set inverse image to A of the sheaf represented by P [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] is constant [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. The fibre P_s may be empty.

source.place: Section 03SF (Galois covers of connected schemes); Tags 03P5 (constant sheaves), 0DV6 (pullback compatibility); read online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03SF, https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03P5, https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0DV6

proof.text: The finite-etale connectedness result makes Hom_U(A,P) finite. Let D be the disjoint union of copies of A indexed by this set; for each map i:A -> P the graph (i,id) gives a section into R=A times_U P. The coproduct of these sections is a morphism D -> R. On the fibre at a, decompose each point of D into its unique summand. Injectivity and surjectivity are precisely the evaluation bijection. The fibre functor for the connected scheme A reflects isomorphisms, so D -> R is an isomorphism.

Construct the presheaf map from the constant presheaf ULift Hom_U(A,P) to the representable sheaf of D: the element i gives W.hom followed by the i-th coprojection. It is locally injective: unequal indices agreeing as sections force W empty by disjointness of summands, so the empty family covers W. It is locally surjective: pull back the summand inclusions along any section W -> D; these etale open immersions cover W and the section is constant on each. Factor through sheafification and apply Sheaf.isLocallyBijective_iff_isIso. Thus the sheaf of D is constant, and its isomorphism to R transports constancy.

Apply nonempty_inverseImage_representable_iso to identify the inverse image of the sheaf represented by P with the representable sheaf of R. Transport the constancy just proved along that isomorphism. All constructions allow an empty index set.
